scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.format: prettier --write app.js js scripts sw.js tests styles.css *.html */index.html *.webmanifest package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app.js js scripts sw.js tests styles.css *.html */index.html *.webmanifest package.json
scripts.syntax: node --check app.js && find js -type f -name '*.js' -not -path 'js/vendor/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check sw.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run architecture && npm run format:check && npm run syntax && npm test
